[EN] Free. Thank Kaia, I'm free!

Ugh—I think you've done me in, .

[EN] No, no...it's better this way. I couldn't live with the shame of my actions.

Suryati leads the argons. I'll have to leave him to you. Heh. Tell him I said hello.

Wait here while I open the portal. Careful! It'll take time...and they'll know you're coming."It was the only way.""Good."
[ES] No, no... es mejor así. No podría vivir con la vergüenza de mis actos.

Suryati lidera a los argons. Tendré que dejártelo a ti. Je. Dale saludos de mi parte.

Espera aquí mientras abro el portal. ¡Ten cuidado! Tomará tiempo... y sabrán que vienes."It was the only way.""Good."
